messages:
kevin_cs: Quick flag  HarborLane onboarding: noticed a sharp increase in cost and a wobble in tail latency since the model family swap. Renewal health went from green->yellow. Need a short, customer-safe list of mitigations we can propose in today's sync.

mira_eng: Do we have a traffic breakdown? percent under 600 tokens?

kevin_cs: ~80% are short KB/FAQ queries (80-450 tokens). A few long summarize jobs spike cost. Link: https://rwd.io/harborlane/traffic.

samira_ml: Low-risk plan: 1) route FAQ traffic to a smaller candidate (rw-micro-v1-int4) for <=480 tokens, 2) enable persistent KV prefix caching for system prompts, 3) cap max_tokens for FAQ to 220. Run focused KB eval.

mira_eng: Also add token-aware routing rule and a small canary. I'll prepare a rule snippet for the CS playbook.

leo_sre: Ops snippet to paste into Console (share with customer):
```json
{
  "route":"account:harborlane",
  "rules":[
    {"if":"prompt_tokens <= 480","model":"rw-micro-v1-int4","max_tokens":220},
    {"else":"rw-large-v2-quant"}
  ],
  "fallback":"rw-large-v2"
}
```
(rollback: instant fallback to rw-large-v2).

mira_eng: I'll run a 5% canary for 90 minutes and monitor p50/p95/p99, regen-error-rate, and token-delta. If regen-error-rate > 0.6% we revert automatically.

samira_ml: I'll run a 120-case KB exact-match + factuality eval on rw-micro-v1-int4 and post a pass/fail. Expected win: routed slice unit cost down ~40-55%, p99 reduced ~20-35ms.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Canary scheduled account:harborlane canary_id=canary-7620001111 at 7620001125 (pct=5). Monitoring p95/p99, regen-error-rate, token-delta.

kevin_cs: Action items: 1) Samira run KB eval (ETA 12h). 2) Mira schedule canary and post metrics (ETA after canary). 3) Kevin will brief AE and request customer do 30 manual KB checks during canary. Thanks team :thumbsup:
